Note: SW 0.3.0 - background music over the DFPlayer Mini, plus the 0x2000 dip fix that 0.2.1 carried and that never made it into a baseline of its own. TWO changes in these numbers, so read the deltas as a sum. (1) 0x2000 is a normal dip position now, sw_state(0), with only bit 6 overwritten by dma_toggle, exactly as PinMAME dipg1_r does it for offset 0. It used to be a fully synthesised byte with bit 7 hard 0 and bits 5..0 hard 1, which made a closed dip 0 invisible to the game while FA-Control showed it correctly on tile 0. Rom proof in docs/Switch_Reading_Analysis.md - 0x721C collects bit 7 of 0x2000 into the dip loop 0x7200-0x7229, 0x78BE and 0x78C9 poll bit 6. Comb -35 against 0.2.0 because bits 7 and 5..0 of the 0x2000 branch now equal the default branch and the 16 bit comparator survives for bit 6 alone. (2) The new rtl/common/dfplayer_cmd.vhd drives SB_Audio, which was tied to 0 until now, as a 9600 baud uart to the DFPlayer Mini fitted as Audio1. Sender is a second instance of the existing rtl/fa_control/uart_tx.vhd with g_CLKS_PER_BIT 5208, not the GottFA1_PLuS home-made shifter on its own 9600 Hz clock - one clock domain fewer and nothing to add to the sdc. Trigger is the flipper control relay Q12, latch 0x1088 bit 6, taken from the same mux as the physical coil output so FA-Control can drive it on the bench. Enabled by options(1), boot matrix, which was free since the FRAM feature went on hold. Comb +158 and Reg +92 against 0.2.1 for that module, the biggest single item being the 27 bit wait counter behind START_DELAY and GLITCH_CYCLES. Memory UNCHANGED at 202752 and pins UNCHANGED at 85 of 89, the acceptance criteria. Slack 2.897 -> 1.868, tight domain is cpu_clk as always, inside the 1.5 ns tolerance but the largest single drop in a while - worth watching at the next feature. Warnings unchanged at 4. Derivation of the trigger, sd card layout and bench procedure: docs/Background_Music.md. Lead variant, hardware tested through SW 0.1.7 and again with this release: the 0.3.0 bitstream was programmed and runs on the board, and SB_Audio is CONFIRMED on the RX pin of the DFPlayer - the open point of the draft note is closed. What is still untested is the music FUNCTION itself, that is whether the player actually starts and pauses with the flipper relay. These are the SYNTHESIS numbers.

SW 0.3.0 - see the cyclone_10_pcb note. HARDWARE TESTED FOR THE FIRST TIME with this release: the 0.3.0 bitstream was programmed and runs on the dev_open board and SB_Audio reaches the RX pin of the DFPlayer there as well, so the standing 'never hardware tested' warning of every earlier baseline is gone. Untested here as on the lead variant is only the music function itself. Registers and memory MUST stay identical to cyclone_10_pcb and they are (1532 / 202752). The comb gap to cyclone_10_pcb is 1 with dev_open on the higher side at this bump - it was 9 the other way at 0.2.0 and 5 at 0.1.9. That is the usual constant folding, this board reports 1.3.0 where the other reports 0.3.0 and those version digits feed both the boot info display and the LISY version string. Judge the variants by the gap moving for a reason you cannot name, not by its absolute size. Slack 3.212 -> 2.718. 81 of 89 pins plus 5 virtual (debug_signal[3..7]).
